sources.title: US has lost measles elimination status, global health authorities say
sources.description: Reading Time: 8 minutes The U.S. has officially lost its status as a country where measles is eliminated, a public health triumph secured a quarter century ago. Researchers with direct knowledge of the deliberations on the country’s status told KFF Health News that the Pan American Health Organization reached the conclusion this week: Measles has reestablished regular transmission in the country.

sources.title: NFL official Don Willard will referee two games in one day after FAA ground stop disrupts travel, league says
sources.description: The FAA lifted its nationwide ground stop on Friday night, but the impact will be felt on football fields Sunday. The NFL announced that it had to adjust its officiating assignments for Week 10 games, reassigning officials to games within driving distance of their hometowns. One referee, Don Willard, will officiate two games on the same day.
